text:
Yes — I added note file attachments.

What changed:
- Added backend support for uploading files to a note and downloading them later.
- Added attachment storage and database records.
- Exposed API endpoints for:
  - upload attachment
  - list note attachments
  - download attachment
  - delete attachment
- Updated shared types and API client to support attachments.
- Updated the README to mention the feature.

One note: I didn’t wire the new attachment UI into the note editor yet, so the backend support is there, but the front-end upload/download controls still need to be added if you want the full user-facing experience.
